objective: Use the chosen order and optimal exceptional names to decide the original guards and return witnesses in original order, and show that large unavoidable alternation can coexist with a linear solver.
status: Proved: After optimal swapping, k exceptions give a witness-producing decision bound O((r+1)^2+2^k(r+1)); k=0 takes linear work. Independent blocks can use different linear solvers even when the global k and the number of pads active with both polarities grow linearly.
title: Witnesses on the original guarded stages and limits of the grouping test
